==Notes==
*He shares his spawning points in the Twin Serpent Lakes with [[Gilroy the Stoic]], [[Elvina the Pious]], [[Kathryn the Cold]], [[Brogan the Punisher]] and [[Julen the Devout]]. There are 6 random spawning points, only on maximal 4 can you find a boss at same time, so it is possible that this boss will not spawn. In [[Twin Serpent Lakes (War in Kryta)]] he has 1 spawning point.
